findings.title: Home prices use VND instead of ₫
Home product images have empty alternative text
Detail positive action uses green instead of blue
Narrow Home heading collapses into a word column
Search field has only a placeholder
Search keyword is rendered as HTML
Quantity spinbutton lacks an accessible name
Add action produces no visible feedback on Home and Detail
Home has no route-dependent selected navigation state
Home list and search omit loading indication
No-result search lacks message and illustration
Home request failures have no error feedback
Older search response overwrites newer results
Search label follows unsubmitted draft text
